intro: Ireland is an increasingly popular study destination for international students looking for high-quality education in an English-speaking European country. It is the European base for global technology and pharmaceutical companies, which makes internships and graduate hiring unusually accessible for international students.
why: European HQs of major tech and pharma employers
Strong scholarship support for Indian students
visa: International students generally apply for a Stamp 2 visa. Documents required for the visa: letter of acceptance from an eligible institution; evidence of tuition fee payment, as applicable; proof of sufficient funds; ITRs of sponsors; evidence of medical insurance; valid passport and supporting documentation; English-language evidence where applicable; and a visa SOP.
intakes: September is the main intake, January is secondary. Apply 7–9 months ahead.

req.label: Academics
req.value: 60%+ in bachelor's (2:1 equivalent for top programmes)

req.label: English test
req.value: IELTS 6.5 overall with 6.0 in each band

req.label: Funds
req.value: €10,000 available for the first year of living costs

req.label: Documents
req.value: Marksheets, Resume, SOP, 2 LORs, CV, transcripts, passport, 28-day bank statement

sch.name: Government of Ireland Scholarships
sch.text: €10,000 stipend plus full tuition waiver for one year

steps.title: Accept offer
steps.text: Pay tuition deposit and receive the acceptance letter

steps.title: Arrange insurance
steps.text: Purchase private medical insurance valid in Ireland

steps.title: Show funds
steps.text: Evidence of required funds in your or your sponsor's account

steps.title: Apply for visa
steps.text: Submit the AVATS online application with supporting documents

steps.title: Biometrics
steps.text: Submit documents to the VFS; decisions in 4–8 weeks

work: Stamp 2 permission allows 20 hours a week during term and 40 hours in holiday periods. Master's graduates get a 2-year Third Level Graduate Programme stay-back to find skilled employment.
workPoints: Critical Skills permit for long-term stay

faq.q: Why is Ireland popular for tech?
faq.a: Google, Meta, Microsoft, Apple, Pfizer and many other tech and pharma companies run European operations from Ireland, creating graduate demand.
Most universities require it, though some accept English-medium instruction letters.

faq.q: How long does the visa take?
faq.a: Typically 4–8 weeks, so apply as soon as you have paid the deposit.
Spouses may accompany you but usually cannot work on a student dependant stamp.
